issues: The headline is a single 64px line; surrounded by eight cards it has almost no weight and no hierarchy
Pale pastel background, eight white cards and a yellow sticky-note marker read like a template display, with no light or depth
Depth is only a +/-9% scale: near and far cards are equally sharp and bright, so the ring looks flat
Each tile animates in its own colour (purple, green, yellow), competing with the title instead of sharing one accent
The title blurs out at the end, so the final frame is just a ring of cards rather than a finished frame
changes: Look switched to lime: graphite stage with a top light, the marker becomes the only neon block in the frame; all eight tiles rebuilt as dark product cards that use the same lime as their only accent

Headline split into two levels: a 64px grey lead-in plus a 156px hero line, with slower, heavier staggering on the hero; as the marker sweeps, two clipped layers flip the glyphs from white to ink like a highlighter stroke
Stronger depth: +/-12% scale, far cards dimmed and slightly defocused, near cards top-lit; the elliptical orbit is drawn as a hairline on entry; a dark scrim between cards and title keeps it legible

Re-timed: ring opens in 24f expo-out, tiles start playing at f24, both title lines blur-slide in, marker springs across at f50 (damping 20), mono kicker at f60, then 2.9s of steady orbit with a 2.5% camera push
Duration 130 to 150f, ending on a complete poster; the original blur-out handoff is kept behind a HANDOFF_EXIT switch
